confirm.title: Add {model}
confirm.description: Roundhouse found {model} ({device_id}). Confirm to add it. You build its views in the Roundhouse page in the sidebar.

abort.discovery_only: Roundhouse devices are discovered over MQTT. Power on the device and wait for it to be announced.
abort.not_roundhouse: The message is not a Roundhouse announce.
abort.invalid_profile: The device profile is not usable: {detail}. See Repairs.

data_description.presence_grace_hours: How long an offline device still counts as home.

profile_invalid.title: Device {device} sent an unusable profile
profile_invalid.description: Roundhouse cannot use the profile of {device}: {detail}. It publishes only the contract version to this device until the profile is fixed.

contract_mismatch.title: Device {device} uses another contract version
contract_mismatch.description: The contract versions do not match ({detail}). Update Roundhouse or the device. Roundhouse publishes only the contract version to this device until they match.

mqtt_birth_disabled.title: The MQTT birth message is disabled
mqtt_birth_disabled.description: Devices learn that Home Assistant is up from the birth message on homeassistant/status. Enable it in the MQTT integration options.

view_overflow.title: View {view} does not fit on {device}
view_overflow.description: The view {view} has too many tiles for {device}: remove {excess}. Its layout holds {capacity}. The device does not show this view.

view_layout_gone.title: View {view} has no layout on {device}
view_layout_gone.description: The layout of the view {view} is no longer offered by {device}. Open the Roundhouse page and choose another layout. The device does not show this view.

send_alert.name: Send alert
send_alert.description: Show an alert on one or more panels, with an optional snapshot and action buttons.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: The Roundhouse panels that show the alert.

camera_entity.name: Camera
camera_entity.description: A camera whose snapshot is attached.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: An http or https address of a snapshot.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Buttons on the alert: a list of objects with id, label, action (domain.service), target, data, and confirm.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: A new alert with the same tag replaces the old one.

acknowledge_alert.name: Acknowledge alert
acknowledge_alert.description: Mark alerts as read, by alert ID or by tag. Without a target, every panel is searched.

device_id.name: Devices
device_id.description: Limit the search to these panels. Without it, every panel is searched.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Acknowledge every alert with this tag.
